reviews.t: Works better than smaller clippers. So glad I purchased!
reviews.x: Thank goodness! I had a really painful nail growing into my right big toe. I looked for my old clippers for a day or so.. then broke down and purchased this kit (I’ve been meaning to get the tools that help lift the skin). This clipper is almost twice the size of my old one, but that didn’t effect precision like I thought it would. I used the skin lifter to uncover the bit of nail pinching my skin and then clipped the bit. Instant relief! Easier to use than my smaller pair, tools were helpful to

I really like the packaging of this product. Arrived in a sturdy metal tin. But even more important than that they work great. Curved nails thick nails fungus nails didn't matter. The little tools that came with it were also a great help. Would highly recommend this product to everyone.

I have to say I had my doubts this would stand up to the description of the product. But I was so wrong! This is a superior medical grade product. It feels very comfortable in your hand. It is easy to use and very sharp, which you need to work fast on ingrown nails. It makes precise cuts. I have purchased many others and they just don't hold up to iMethodbeauty's product. I would recommend this to anyone.

reviews.t: Best clippers I have ever owned
reviews.x: This set is really nice and comes in a very nice cushioned tin. The lifter does its job perfectly and lifts the nail easily. The double ended file is fantastic and I don't know how I have lived without one of these. It makes filing your big toe so much easier than trying to fit a regular file in the tight area between your nail and skin at the sides of the nail. The clippers though are the real star of the set. They go through a toe nail like a hot knife through butter. The nail was easy to prec

This set is really great.  The nippers are super sharp.  Big rubberized grips are easy and comfortable to hold.  Feels like you could cut high gauge wires with them.  Accessories are items I did not realize I needed until I used them.  These small straight and bent files are perfect for rounding off my toe nail to reduce (but not eliminate) my ingrown toe nails.  The metal box and foam insert are surprisingly good quality.  The whole packet just works.  Would reccomend them to anyone.  Would buy

Let me get the bad news out first.  The first set of clippers I got were a dud -- the springs where misplaced and one of the jaws snapped the first time I used it.  However...  I note to the seller got me a same day response, a refund, and a replacement set of clippers.  No questions, no hassle.  I was very impressed.  The new clippers are working just fine.  I have found the additional tools very useful.  Again, kudos to the seller for being so responsive and customer-focused.
I used this on my husbands ingrown toe nail and it worked great!  It is just what was needed to provide pain relief!

These are extremely well made. They have ergonomic grips which are great for anyone that has arthritis or limited mobility or even strength. I really like how the blades are curved up at the top to help in cutting. These are wonderful for the thicker nails or the ones that crumble due to foot fungus. These are much better than the price might suggest.  The clippers are easy to use right or left handed. They come packaged in a nice looking metal box, it's nice enough to give as a gift for someone

reviews.t: This clipper is a necessary tool.
reviews.x: The older I get, the more unique my toenails are. This tool is excellent. I have used other types of clippers with the same frustrating results – it’s harder than it should be.  But with this tool you can do precision cutting, or just normal clipping.  It fits well in my hand without needing a lot of strength to squeeze the handle. If I lost this clipper, I would order one as soon as possible. I highly recommend this clipper.

This thing works.  When this is what you need.  This is what you need.

reviews.t: Toenail Clippers for Thick Nails could use a spring added to grip
reviews.x: Toenail Clippers for Thick Nails - iMethod Surgical Grade Stainless Steel Ingrown Toenail Tool Set is made of good quality steel. The kit is presented in a nice zippered case. I like the set but as a person/woman with not a very strong grip I had a hard time cutting my big toe nail. I had to use both hands and the end result was not a pretty cut. If there were a spring added between the handles to help the grasp of the handles of the clippers it would have been better for me. But my grip may not

I used this clipper three times and on the third time, the metal snapped and it broke in half.  And no, my toenails are not so gnarly they caused this. These are cheaply made with inferior metal. Very disappointing and a waste of money!!!

Like other reviews I agree this product seems well made and is a great set with the extra tools. I bought it after my new YouTube fascination with toes and got brave enough to tackle my thick toenails. The clipper handle is way too big and bulky for me to handle and the tip of the clippers is long and curved.  All together it was just too big for my hand and toes.  They also did not cut as easily as I would have hoped for. I will likely return

reviews.t: This was a nail kit that worked wonders on my ...
reviews.x: This was a nail kit that worked wonders on my thick toenail.  I have one very thick big toe nail due to fungus, it would seem. This clipper was able to help me to cut through in ways that other cutters could not (from other toe nail clippers to even wire cutting tools).  Also included are two scrapers to loosen matter under the nail and do whatever else they are designed to do, and then a handy holding case for all three items.

I am revising my original review.  Although the product does not work for me, it is well made and probably would work for people who have better dexterity.  The seller went above and beyond to resolve my issue.  The product is superior to others on the market that are described as being for thick toenails, but really are not.  These clippers certainly can accommodate thick nails and they are very sharp.

This product is perfect for my ingrown toenails. Very well packaged in a padded, tin case so I can easily travel with it as well! The small tools are extremely helpful and sharp. Would definitely recommend this product to anyone.

reviews.t: Buy from this Company. Extremely Highly Recommend
reviews.x: This product was 100 times better than I expected. Packaged beautiful.  Definitely the best Surgical grade of Steel.  You can’t buy anything like this in my county. Shapes and trims, perfectly.
These tools arrived in a protective, aluminum container. They're quality items and seems quit durable. I am super pleased with this purchase and will look for other items by this company.

claims.text: Most reviewers find the clippers sharp, precise, and effective on thick, curved, or ingrown nails.
Several reviewers report the clippers broke or fell apart on first use or after only a few uses.
Reviewers praise the included accessories and tools, such as the lifter and files, as helpful.
The comfortable, ergonomic grips and easy handling are frequently highlighted.
Some reviewers had durability issues but received responsive customer service with refunds or replacements.
